title: Remove Interval
summary: Given a sorted list of disjoint intervals representing a set of real numbers, and another interval to be removed, return a new sorted list of disjoint intervals with the toBeRemoved interval excluded.
statement: Given a sorted list of disjoint intervals representing a set of real numbers, and another interval to be removed, return a new sorted list of disjoint intervals with the toBeRemoved interval excluded. Each interval in the output is in the form [a, b) and represents the set of real numbers that are in the original intervals but not in toBeRemoved.
constraints: Input intervals are sorted and pairwise disjoint.
Remove the half-open interval and retain nonempty fragments.
hints: Keep disjoint intervals; for overlap, retain the portions strictly left of a and right of b.
Append only nonempty fragments in traversal order.
Set subtraction from one interval can create at most those two fragments.
editorial: Set subtraction from one interval can create at most those two fragments.

tests.explanation: A middle removal splits one interval into two fragments.
